department.instructions: Which department should handle the main subject of this request?

criteria.technical: Technical problems with the app, login, or service
criteria.sales: Information about buying new plans, pricing, or contracts
criteria.other: Delivery, general information, feedback, or anything else

churn_risk.instructions: Does the user explicitly threaten to stop using the service or switch to another provider?

criteria.false: No, there is no threat to leave the service
criteria.true: Yes, there is a threat to leave the service, even if conditional

urgency.instructions: How urgent is the request based on the stated deadline and whether work is blocked?
criteria: Not urgent; no deadline or it can wait
Needed soon or by tomorrow; work is not currently blocked
Needed now or today; imminent deadline or work is blocked
